You step into your backyard, eager to soak up some sun now that you’re home for summer vacation. You’ve been planning to use your parents’ pool all day, and you’re excited as you shut the sliding door behind you. You pause—you didn’t realize your father had a few friends over. They’re all by the grill, sharing drinks. Tightening the towel around your waist, you give them a half-hearted smile. 
Your dad waves you over to introduce yourself and you can’t help but notice the older men gazing hungrily at your body. 
You lock eyes with the youngest and certainly most attractive of the group, a handsome blonde with stormy blue eyes. He tips his whiskey glass up at you, and offers you a crooked smile, greeting you.
“Name’s Leon.”
